title: Like most ads - doesn’t fully match
body: I was in another merge game when I saw the ad for this one. I have a screen shot but it said: “We want to take this opportunity to solemnly promise that our game will: 1. remain completely free 2. never have ads 3. continue to create high-quality. fun gameplay, like the 10,000+ levels we've already designed! If you download our game now you'll receive an exclusive $100 in-game gift pack! Come and play now!” I am a fan of these types of merge games. And this isn’t a bad one. But, 1) I didn’t get the $100 in-game gift pack; I didn’t fully expect to but I was curious. 2) not long in to playing, I got a forced ad break (with 5 energy); I just downloaded it from an ad where the solemnly swore it would never have ads, lol. Then they offered to go ad-free for a cost. That’s all fine and dandy and I get that developers want to make money off of their free games but then don’t put that it is ad-free in your ads from other games (other games where watching the ad is optional to earn a reward—not forced on you.) Like I said, the merging aspect wasn’t bad and I enjoyed it for a little while but not even 12 hours later I am deleting it because the ad to get me to download it was misleading.
